sourceScope: Source and tests are identified by the implementation commit containing this evidence. Current source SHA-256 hashes normalize CRLF to LF; artifact SHA-256 hashes use original file bytes. history preserves the earlier source snapshot and first native failure without overwriting originals.
supportedInput: Authenticated unexpired envelope; exact command input {runId}; existing runId equals batchId; whole immutable batch target of at most 100 jobs.
safetyContracts: Suggest and bounded-auto cancellation always require fresh human approval. Observe rejects; globalPause permits approved cancellation while continuing to block enqueue.

The existing workspace CAS ledger stores typed cancellation records and preserves legacy enqueue records. Operation-key uniqueness spans enqueue and cancel; cancellation is excluded from generation exposure and concurrency sums.

Consent binds authenticated actor, original request, policy revision, exact immutable batch/job snapshot target hash and canonical grant digest. No caller-provided force, job subset, discard, reservation abandon or retry authority.
Queue cancellation persists agent-cancel:<64 lowercase hex grant digest> before runtime abort. Existing user/batch/shutdown reasons remain compatible.

Consumed grants never authorize a second cancel call. Recovery requires exact target plus matching operation marker or verifiable stop facts predating canonical consent time; partial or unknown outcomes remain unknown.
cancel-requested acknowledges durable cancellation intent, not immediate termination or remote Provider work/billing cancellation. Terminal jobs and other batches remain unchanged.

Ordinary unused output reservations follow existing cancellation abandonment rules. Unknown Provider and verified/spooled output evidence, receipts, reservations and collision claims remain preserved.
Queue startup settles Provider/spool/output/lease facts before finishing cancellation markers, including exhausted-attempt recovery. Cancellation does not prove settled enqueue exposure or a refund.

review.method: Independent code review followed by root integration and final regression.
resolved: Existing Queue markers could be stranded after non-running recovery; preserve original marker/time and finalize through the existing cancel transaction.
Persist operation marker before AbortController abort to avoid losing exact identity on fast executor completion.
Exhausted-attempt lease recovery must finalize an existing cancellation marker without discarding unknown/spooled facts.
Reject forged previously-stopped arrays and terminal facts created only after consent; canonical consent time and persisted Queue stop facts are required.

Actual native job IDs in previouslyStoppedJobIds were rejected by the generic binary scanner after cancellation. Add only the exact previouslystoppedjobids opaque identifier field; preserve credential, image, encoded image and absolute path rejection.
review.boundaryHardening: Operation ID length assertions explicitly strengthen a boundary that already rejected the input. They are not evidence of a reproduced implementation defect.
